scope: Static named producer ledger for Guardian collision-address compatibility. Full-world runtime producer order remains the integrating enemy-phase task; this is not a generic scratch-memory interface.
known_semantic_projections: Successful DFEC/DFEE/DFF4: low=TerrainSample.Column, high=TerrainSample.SourceIndex, even when result is empty for Y>=224.
EB99/EB9B Y+dy overflow: high=probeX, low preserved.
Guardian B686 neighbor and B69B lower wall: explicit 16-bit address arithmetic.
entry_dependencies: Earlier player/projectile and terrain-scroll phases can write these bytes too. E54F entry must receive the real semantic projection, not zero or an assumed graphics address.
not_established: A bounded search of retained REA functions found no direct writes in E10A/E276 or recovered aiming routines, but unobserved branches/indirect writes are not excluded. Full-phase recording should retain PC, bank and slot for actual writes.
